A basic mushroom dish made by lightly salting mushrooms and grilling them.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Salt-Grilled Mushrooms}}
A basic mushroom dish made by lightly salting mushrooms and grilling them.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Salt-Grilled Mushrooms are made by [[Cooking]] any [[Mushroom]] with [[Rock Salt]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. The default can be made either by using [[Hylian Shroom]]s, which offer no status effects, or by using two types of Mushrooms with differing effects. Eating them will restore some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. These [[Meal]]s are noted to be simple, their preparation only requiring one to lightly salt Mushrooms before grilling them. Based on both the type of Mushroom added and the inclusion of other [[Ingredient]]s, the following variations of Salt-Grilled Mushrooms can be made: * '''Hearty Salt-Grilled Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Salt-Grilled Mushrooms}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A basic mushroom dish made by lightly salting mushrooms and grilling them.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Truffle]]s, [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s, or other hearty Ingredients. When eaten, they will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Energizing Salt-Grilled Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Salt-Grilled Mushrooms}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A basic mushroom dish made by lightly salting mushrooms and grilling them.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Stamella Shroom]]s or other energizing Ingredients. They can be eaten to refill part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Enduring Salt-Grilled Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Salt-Grilled Mushrooms}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A basic mushroom dish made by lightly salting mushrooms and grilling them.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Endura Shroom]]s or other enduring Ingredients. Link's Stamina Wheel can be completely restored and overfilled by eaten these meals. * '''Hasty Salt-Grilled Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Salt-Grilled Mushrooms}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A basic mushroom dish made by lightly salting mushrooms and grilling them.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Rushroom]]s or other hasty Ingredients. If they're eaten, Link will receive a boost to his movement speed. * '''Spicy Salt-Grilled Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Salt-Grilled Mushrooms}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A basic mushroom dish made by lightly salting mushrooms and grilling them.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Sunshroom]]s or other spicy Ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] when they're eaten. * '''Electro Salt-Grilled Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Salt-Grilled Mushrooms}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
A basic mushroom dish made by lightly salting mushrooms and grilling them.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Zapshroom]]s or other electric Ingredients. Link can eat them to receive one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Salt-Grilled Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Salt-Grilled Mushrooms}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A basic mushroom dish made by lightly salting mushrooms and grilling them.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Razorshroom]]s or other mighty Ingredients. By eating them, Link will receive a boost to the power of his attacks. * '''Tough Salt-Grilled Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Salt-Grilled Mushrooms}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
A basic mushroom dish made by lightly salting mushrooms and grilling them.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Ironshroom]]s or other tough Ingredients. When Link eats them, he will gain a boost to his defensive abilities. * '''Sneaky Salt-Grilled Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Salt-Grilled Mushrooms}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
A basic mushroom dish made by lightly salting mushrooms and grilling them.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Silent Shroom]]s or other sneaky Ingredients. Link's [[Stealth]] will be boosted if he eats these meals. * '''Chilly Salt-Grilled Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Salt-Grilled Mushrooms}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A basic mushroom dish made by lightly salting mushrooms and grilling them.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Chillshroom]]s or other chilly Ingredients. They can be eaten to grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Salt-Grilled Mushrooms have the same [[Recipe]] that they did in {{BotW}}, which involves [[Cooking]] a piece of [[Rock Salt]] with any kind of [[Mushroom]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Mushroom Skewer }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Salt-Grilled Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
